dossier.scp_unleashed.261.title: Pan-dimensional Vending
dossier.scp_unleashed.261.caption: SCP-261 at intake. Nobody has translated the sign.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-261 stands against a wall in a monitored break room. It is to be used for approved testing only. Every item it dispenses is logged and kept in a sealed evidence bag, and is not to be eaten outside a test. %rThe coin slot is not a donation box.%r
SCP-261 has twice been found in a different room from the one it was left in. Its position is to be checked at the start of every shift.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-261 is a snack machine about two metres tall, of a faded retro design, enamelled in sun-bleached green with brass trim. Its sign and price strips are printed in a script nobody has identified. It has no power cord and no visible way of being restocked.

When a small iron or gold coin is fed into its slot, SCP-261 whirrs, turns one of its spirals and drops a packaged snack into its tray. No two tests have produced the same run of snacks, and some products turn up far less often than others. The snacks are edible and taste ordinary, but each one has an anomalous effect on whoever eats it. Most effects wear off within a minute or two.
Now and then SCP-261 keeps the coin and gives nothing. Now and then it gives two.

page.title: Addendum 261-1: Test Log
text: Test 261-04: D-1182 inserted an iron coin and received a pink packet of gum. He jumped, and took a long time to come back down. He described it as brilliant.
Test 261-09: D-1182 received a tin of mints. He reported that the room had turned upside down. The recordings show that it had not.

Test 261-15: Researcher Okafor inserted a gold coin and received two items, a bag of kibble and a box of sour sweets. A puppy appeared beside her and followed her until the end of the shift. %rIt has not been seen since.%r
Test 261-22: D-0457 inserted an iron coin. The machine whirred and dispensed nothing. D-0457 kicked the machine. Nothing further was dispensed.

page.title: Addendum 261-2: Recovery
page.text: SCP-261 has no recovery record. It was found humming in a corridor close to a reader of this file, shortly after the file was opened. See field notes.

block.scp_unleashed.scp261_vending.toolt: A faded snack machine from somewhere else. The labels are printed in no alphabet anyone recognises.
block.scp_unleashed.scp261_vending.pay: Use an iron or gold nugget on it to pay
block.scp_unleashed.scp261_vending.wait: It needs a moment to settle between snacks
message.scp_unleashed.scp261.hint: The coin slot looks hungry for a nugget.
message.scp_unleashed.scp261.busy: The machine is still humming to itself.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp261_vending.1: SCP-261 is a faded snack machine of no known make. Use an iron or gold nugget on it, and after a short whirr something drops into its tray and pops out.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp261_vending.2: Nobody has worked out what it will give you. Some snacks turn up far less often than others, and staff say the machine seems to treat gold differently. Now and then it keeps the coin.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp261_vending.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-261 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; the machine turns up nearby soon after.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp261.0: It turns up close to whoever reads this file.
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp261_static: %1$s was zapped by a static spark
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_gravity_gum.to: Chew slowly. The floor is more of a suggestion than a rule.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_echo_crisps.to: Every crunch gets a second opinion, and then a third.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_static_soda.to: Shake well before drinking. Then shake hands with someone you dislike.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_mirror_mints.t: Fresh breath and a fresh perspective, possibly the wrong way up.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_hollow_bar.too: There is nothing inside. Ask it again later.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_frost_fizz.too: Served below zero. Best enjoyed near a lake you would rather not swim in.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_lucky_wafer.to: Every fourth wafer is the lucky one. This is always the fourth.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_ember_jerky.to: Smoked over a fire that is, technically, still going.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_ink_toffee.too: Closes your eyes and opens something else.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_weight_gummies: Each gummy weighs exactly one regret.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_taste_of_tomor: Tastes like a full stomach you have not earned yet.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_pocket_pretzel: Snack sized. Results may also be snack sized.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_rewind_raisins: A handful of a moment ago. Mind where you were standing.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_hiccup_pops.to: It pops in your mouth, and then it keeps on popping.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_mob_morsels.to: Best shared with a friend. The friend comes in the bag.
item.scp_unleashed.scp261_fright_bites.t: So sour that monsters can smell it from across the room.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_buoyant.desc: A fizzy lightness. Every step wants to leave the ground a little longer.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_echoing.desc: Whatever you do, somewhere nearby does it again.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_charged.desc: Your fingertips crackle. The next thing you strike will feel it.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_topsy.descri: Your sense of up and down has wandered off.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_hollow.descr: Something was eaten, but nothing arrived. Yet.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_frostfoot.de: A chill runs down to your soles and keeps going.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_fortunate.de: Things fall your way, and sometimes they fall twice.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_smoldering.d: You are warm all the way through. So is anything you touch.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_inksight.des: Darkness in front of your eyes, and shapes behind it.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_heavy.descri: Everything about you weighs more than it should.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_borrowed.des: A full stomach, on loan. The loan comes due.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_pocket.descr: You fit in places you did not fit in before.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_rewinding.de: Somewhere behind you, a moment is waiting to be returned to.
effect.scp_unleashed.scp261_dread.descri: Something about you makes monsters remember urgent business elsewhere.
